visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a blue T-shirt, khaki shorts, and a grey baseball cap is seen dribbling a basketball on a wooden floor in a modern living room. A large white Labrador Retriever wearing a blue harness follows him closely, eyes fixed on the ball. The room is brightly lit with sunlight coming from a balcony window, and a person is visible sitting at a desk in the background. (2) The man performs dynamic basketball moves, dribbling between his legs while the dog playfully tries to intercept the ball. The man's facial expression is joyful as he smiles at the camera. He approaches a small white basketball hoop mounted on a door and takes a shot. (3) The man continues the game, moving across the living room and into the dining area. He holds the ball up high, and the dog jumps excitedly. The background features a sofa, a TV, and shelves filled with toys and collectibles. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen. (4) In the final phase, the man makes a successful shot into the mini-hoop. He then walks back toward the camera, holding the basketball and smiling, while the dog continues to follow him with high energy.
